post.summary: Send a message and stream the reply
post.description: Answers with `text/event-stream`. Events arrive in this order: `turn` once, then `text`, `tool` and `approval` as the reply is written, then `done` or `error`. Each event's data is JSON whose `type` repeats the event name. The reply keeps being written if the connection closes; reload the messages to get it. A thread runs one reply at a time (`409`), and `503` means this node cannot reach Claude.
